_comment: Grid search for the ema-default topology (w_ema + build_dseplb + select_all). Sweeps EMA decay rates (beta1, beta2) and the w-scoring variance weight (lam in w = mean + lam*std). lam can be negative (skeptical: deflate volatile experts) or positive (defensive: replicate volatile experts more). Matches the official eval case grid (DS-R1 EP32/64/128/256 + Qwen3 EP32/64/128); only the LmSys trace is locally available. Qwen3 EP256 is auto-skipped (D > E).
